overloads.semanticRole: Creates a folder at the given pathname, optionally creating any missing intermediate folders recursively when '*' is passed.

constraints: Without the trailing '*' parameter, an error is generated (and no folder created) if any intermediate folder in folderPath does not already exist.

With '*', missing intermediate folders are created recursively and no error is generated; in this mode folderPath may even include a trailing document name, which is ignored while the folder hierarchy above it is still created.
